_source: Every value here was read out of the live database on 27 September 2026, or supplied by the owner in the Master Copy Brief of the same date. Nothing is remembered or assumed.
_nights_source: event_calendar, read 27 September 2026. Start and end times are the live ones: Knockout 19:00 to 21:00 on Monday, Tuesday and Friday; New Power, Petchyindee and Kiatpetch 18:00 to 22:00; RWS 19:10 to 22:00. Doors are the brief's, one hour before the first fight on every night. Knockout finishes between 21:00 and 21:30, confirmed by the owner on 27 September, so those three nights read 9:00 to 9:30 PM. event_calendar holds 21:00 as the nominal end; the brief said 9:30 PM; the owner says the range.
